full_judgment: 2. The facts of the case, in short, are the defendant-petitioner Nos.1 and 2 are the ejmali owners of a tank appertaining to C.S. Plot No.2498 and R.S. Plot No.1265 recorded in C.S. Khatian No.1462 and R.S. Khatian No.801 respectively and land of the Bank of the tank being C.S. Plot No.2499 and R.S. Plot No.1266 total areas measuring 1.15 acres. Ganga Narayan Shaha, defendant No.1 entered into an agreement for sale on 17'1' Ashar, 1398 B.S. corresponding to 2" 1982 with the Plaintiff for sale of the aforesaid suit tank and bank of the tank at a price of TK.49,000.00 and that a sum of Taka 10,000.00 was paid to him as earnest money. It was stipulated that the defendant No.1 along with his brother defendant No.2 within one month from 17'h Ashar, 1398 B.S. would execute and register the deed of sale on receiving balance amount of consideration money from the plaintiff. The plaintiff on 07.07.1991 amended the plaint of the suit by stating that the defendant No.1 as Karta of the family for himself and on behalf of his brother executed the deed of agreement for sale. That defendant No.1 on this or that plea did not execute and register the sale deed and that the plaintiff finding no other alternative filed the suit for Specific Performance of Contract.
